claims.object_text: autosomal dominant or recessive neurodevelopmental disorder with global developmental delay, with or without seizures (AD or AR GRIN1-NDD)
claims.quote: Pathogenic variants in glutamate receptor, ionotropic, NMDA-1 (GRIN1) cause an autosomal dominant or recessive neurodevelopmental disorder with global developmental delay, with or without seizures (AD or AR GRIN1-NDD).
A similarly severe phenotype of intractable epilepsy and infantile death has only been reported in one other family with a homozygous nonsense variant in GRIN1.
biallelic predicted-null variants in GRIN1 can cause a markedly more severe clinical phenotype than AR GRIN1-NDD caused by missense variants.
the phenotype in our patient is much more severe than those seen with homozygous missense variants.
